```{=html}
<section class="contact-section">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="contact-layout">
      <div class="contact-main">
        <div class="contact-intro">
          <p>
            Feel free to shoot me an email if you want to get in touch. I am always looking for a good riddle to think about. Feedback is appreciated and I will do my best to respond and address any comments.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="contact-form-container">
          <h2>Get In Touch</h2>

          <div style="margin-bottom: 1.5rem; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; background: var(--bg-secondary, #f8f9fa); border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #e5e7eb);">
            <h3 style="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">GitHub Issues (preferred for research feedback)</h3>
            <p style="margin-bottom: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-light, #6b7280);">
              For bug reports, critique submissions, or site content feedback, GitHub Issues is the most
              reliable channel — no email client required, and discussions are public and trackable.
            </p>
            <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/new" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="btn-primary" style="display: inline-block; text-decoration: none;">
              Open a GitHub Issue →
            </a>
          </div>

          <div style="margin-bottom: 1.5rem; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; background: var(--bg-secondary, #f8f9fa); border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #e5e7eb);">
            <h3 style="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Email</h3>
            <p style="margin-bottom: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-light, #6b7280);">
              For private inquiries, use the link below to open a pre-addressed message in your email client.
            </p>
            <a href="mailto:dieterolson@AffineDrift.com?subject=AffineDrift%20Inquiry" class="resource-link">
              dieterolson@AffineDrift.com
            </a>
          </div>

          <div style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem; background: var(--bg-secondary, #f8f9fa); border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-color, #f59e0b); border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-light, #6b7280);">
            <strong>Note:</strong> The previous contact form used an HTML mailto action which is unreliable
            across modern browsers and mobile devices. The options above are more robust alternatives.
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <aside class="contact-sidebar">
        <div class="contact-info">
          <h2>Other Ways to Connect</h2>
          <div class="contact-email">
            <p><strong>Email:</strong> <a href="mailto:dieterolson@AffineDrift.com">dieterolson@AffineDrift.com</a></p>
          </div>
          <div class="social-links">
            <p>Follow AffineDrift:</p>
            <ul class="social-list">
              <li><a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization" class="social-link" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub</a></li>

            <p style="margin-top: 1rem; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-light); font-style: italic;">
              Additional social media channels will be added in the future.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div class="contact-note">
            <p>
              <strong>Note:</strong> For technical inquiries about the research or collaboration opportunities,
```
